name: ar-ptitle-v2
about: Part 1 article recording (cap-worst, lead 2026-10-10 option b): the 'People still need people' title's 'o' opening while the title is visible. v1 failed: the heading's IntersectionObserver (threshold 0.35, JS 6261-6267) fires while the #people card is still hidden (opacity 0) under the hero's exit, so the 'o' (1.3 s delay, JS 6250-6257) has opened before the card fades in (headless Chrome check out/wc/ptitle-check.json, both builds: opens at y ~230-370, card visible from y ~675). The observer resets the 'o' when the heading leaves (JS 6264) and reopens it 1.3 s after it re-enters, and the card stays visible above its flip, so this program goes past the title and comes back: reload, 2 s, mark scroll, drags up 520 + 520 + 260 px (2000/2000/1000 ms, 'drag', 250 ms apart; ~1,300 px, the heading off the top), settle, 1.5 s, mark return, one 'still' stroke down 500 px in 2000 ms (finger held, no momentum; back to y ~800, the title sharp in the upper third), settle, mark held, 6 s still, mark end. Same input on both arms; fixed before any capture.
